title: Utilization Management Program Authorization Terms: Periods, Effective Dates and Renewals
content:
These terms govern every approval granted under the Utilization Management Program.

### Clause 1 — Length of an approval

A new prior authorization runs the package's prior authorization approval months from its effective date, or the months the package's named-drug list of first-time approval months gives for the drug; a renewal runs the package's renewal approval months; a step approval runs the package's step therapy approval months; a quantity limit exception runs the package's quantity limit approval months.

### Clause 2 — Expiration date

The expiration date is the day before the same day-of-month that many months later, falling back to the last day of the month when that day does not exist.

### Clause 3 — Effective date

The effective date is the decision date, except that it may be set back up to the package's retroactive days before the decision date to cover a fill the member already paid for, and a renewal approved before the current approval expires takes effect on the package's renewal effective basis, the day after the current expiration date.

### Clause 4 — Strengths

An approval covers only the strength requested unless the package carries approvals over to other strengths of the same drug.

### Clause 5 — Renewal cases

A renewal case may be opened from the package's renewal window days before the current expiration date. When the package requires new clinicals for renewals, a renewal needs documented response to therapy, and a weight-management GLP-1 renewal needs documented loss of at least the package's minimum fraction of baseline weight.

### Clause 6 — Automatic renewal

When the package renews chronic drugs automatically, approvals for drugs on its automatic-renewal list with continuous paid claims renew automatically, with the approval recorded as coming about through automatic renewal.

### Clause 7 — One approval of a type at a time

At most the package's maximum number of approvals in force per drug (one) of the same type is in force for a drug at any time, so a renewal granted early takes effect only the day after the current one expires.

## Worked dates (hypothetical)

| Approval | Effective date | Months | Expiration date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Prior authorization | 15 March 2026 | 12 | 14 March 2027 |
| Quantity limit exception | 1 February 2026 | 6 | 31 July 2026 |
| Step therapy approval | 10 October 2026 | 24 | 9 October 2028 |

A renewal approved on 20 February 2027 for the first approval above, while it is still in force, takes effect on 15 March 2027, the day after the 14 March 2027 expiration, and runs the renewal months from that date.

### Effective date on a decision of 20 May (hypothetical)

| Package retroactive days | Fill the member paid for on | Earliest effective date that covers it |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 10 May | not available — the effective date stays 20 May |
| 14 | 10 May | 10 May (10 days back, within 14) |
| 14 | 1 May | not available — 19 days back exceeds 14 |
| 30 | 1 May | 1 May (19 days back, within 30) |
